page.overview:
Who is Sagat?

Kenny Omega (Season 3 Trailer, dream only)

Bald (Since Street Fighter 1)|species=Human}}

It is generally believed that Sagat is based on a real-life Muay Thai, fighter named Sagat Petchyindee (สกัด เพชรยินดี), but Capcom has yet to confirm this. Alternately some have argued that the inspiration came from the tall, unbeatable Muay Thai fighter Dieselnoi Chor Thanasukarn.

Sagat himself was also said to be inspired by Reiba, the Muay Thai lord from manga Karate Baka Ichidai. Evidence of this shows up in Inafune's original design. Sagat's alternate costume in Street Fighter IV may hint at this, as the costume has matching leggings like Reiba in the manga. In Sagat's Street Fighter profile, he was called "The Dark Lord Emperor of Muai Thai", the same title Reiba had in the manga. The events of Street Fighter, also mirrors the events in Karate Master, where the main protagonist defeats other Muay Thai users to prove his skill to Reiba. Sagat making his return in the sequel was inspired by special episodes of stories where the old enemy returns at the most unexpected time. The scar on his chest was added to show that he was already defeated by the main character.
